verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an inference API/hosting platform; there's no evidence of user data export tools, account data portability, or open-format export beyond the OpenAI-compatible API interface itself (which is about model access, not user data export). No docs describe exporting conversation history, usage data, or account data in open formats. Probe results confirm no llms.txt, docs.md, or OpenAPI spec found. missing for 10: any data export feature, account/data portability documentation, open-format export of usage/history/logs.
